items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024

ctx.x: Yeah. I understand what you’re saying. I’ve also, along the technology lines I’ve heard drummers talk about playing a Broadway show from another room.

Oh yeah. Yeah my friend Warren Odze, he was in another room, he was playing “Shrek.” You don’t even know who you’re playing with. And if you don’t have the mix in your phones you could be way off because you’re looking at the conductor. I had that happen to me.

It’s sort of like that thing we can do this but should we. So last question, John, when did you know that you had the beat? Because you’ve talked about the beat a lot today and was it something you think you were born with or was it early exposure with records?
